issues.topic: Spinning tire fittings and ground artifact
issues.learning: Spatial proximity is not assembly ownership. Inspect a complete wheel cycle with stationary frame visible; remove all parked-stand components, not only its largest mesh.

issues.classification: Director proportion/posture preference plus dependent fit
issues.learning: Move saddle, pelvis, reach and supports together. Bike-only reverse view caught old springs taller than the lowered seat.

issues.classification: Director tempo/spacing refinement plus physical consistency
issues.learning: Record screen-clock speed, deceleration distance and nearest crowd gap. Faster wheels alone do not prove speed; preserving a one-second braking interval after raising speed would imply nearly1.9g.
Housing-derived center and common steering ownership first, then front/side silhouette. The first corrected backing still occluded the lens and was internally rejected.

issues.topic: Pause, slower uncover and direct greeting transition
issues.classification: Director acting/timing refinement; continuity should be anticipated
issues.learning: Annotate settle, attention, decision, reach, pull and greeting separately. No automatic reach on camera cut or needless return to the bar. Inspect partial phases, not only final palm contact.
Back, shoulder, neck, seat and both arm routes are one sling interface. A diagonal prop is not enough; the second route still crossed the neck and was internally replaced with shoulder support.

issues.topic: Clouds, textured moon and clear lunar opening
issues.learning: Separate moon surface, cloud coverage and clear-space composition. A visible moon against cloud texture does not satisfy a cloud-free opening. Preserve the liked palette.

issues.topic: Spear ground strike during horse rear
issues.learning: Annotate the action from contiguous original reference frames and explicit Director intent. Ground-contact prop needs independent world ownership and a shared hand target; rider-parenting cannot supply a strike.
